name: routing_v1
instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which specific issue is the message about?

criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment on the account that the customer does not recognise or did not make
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash/ATM withdrawal the customer did not make or does not recognise
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer does not recognise or did not set up
criteria.unknown_money_or_transaction: Money or a transaction the customer says they did NOT make or authorise and cannot account for (possible fraud). Not for transactions the customer made themselves.
criteria.own_transaction_query: Receipts or records for a payment or transfer the customer made themselves, or finding a past transaction in the app
criteria.compromised_card: Card details may be compromised, stolen or used by someone else
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card lost or stolen; reporting it, or found it again after reporting
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone lost or stolen; protecting the account/app
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot app passcode / password, cannot log in
criteria.request_refund: Wants a refund from a merchant or asks how refunds work
criteria.refund_not_showing: A refund they were promised is not showing up on the account
criteria.charged_twice: Same transaction charged twice / duplicate charge
criteria.wrong_cash_amount: The customer did not receive the cash from a withdrawal, or the ATM gave less cash than requested or expected, even if they suspect an exchange-rate error
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment the customer made was cancelled, terminated, reverted or returned to the account by the bank or merchant, and they ask why
criteria.card_arrival: New card hasn't arrived / delivery time / tracking
criteria.order_card: Ordering a physical card, spare/additional card, replacement card
criteria.virtual_card: Getting or using a virtual or disposable virtual card, its limits or why it doesn't work
criteria.card_not_working: The card itself is not working, broken or damaged, or contactless does not work
criteria.declined_card_payment: A purchase or card payment the customer tried to make was declined or refused
criteria.card_expiry: Card about to expire, renewing card
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted, which ATMs/merchants
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card to the app or account
criteria.pin: Changing PIN, PIN blocked, where to find PIN
criteria.atm_support: General ATM usage / declined cash withdrawal
criteria.apple_google_pay: Apple Pay / Google Pay setup or use
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether card is Visa or Mastercard, which card brands supported
criteria.transfer_status: Transfer pending, how long transfers take, not received by recipient
criteria.transfer_failed: Transfer failed, declined, or beneficiary not allowed
criteria.cancel_transfer: Cancel or reverse a transaction, transfer or payment the customer sent, including money sent to the wrong account or wrong recipient
criteria.cancel_purchase: Cancel a purchase or an order the customer bought from a merchant
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving money or salary into the account, including receiving it in another currency; transfer into account; balance not updated after a transfer
criteria.top_up: Topping up the account: how to, top-up methods, top-up pending/failed/reverted, limits, auto top-up
criteria.pending_card_payment_or_withdrawal: A card payment or ATM cash withdrawal that is still pending or has not gone through yet, or the balance looks wrong after a card payment or ATM withdrawal
criteria.cash_cheque_deposit: Depositing cash or cheque, balance not updated after deposit
criteria.card_payment_fee: Why a fee was charged on a payment or purchase the customer made (e.g. a fee on a card payment, a foreign purchase, or when buying something)
criteria.top_up_fee: Fee for topping up by card or bank transfer
criteria.extra_charge: A mysterious extra charge or fee appearing on the statement or app (e.g. an extra £1) that the customer cannot tie to anything or thinks is an error
criteria.exchange_rate: Exchange rates, wrong exchange rate applied, exchange charges, currency exchange in app
criteria.currencies_supported: Which currencies, card types or international transfer networks (e.g. SWIFT) the bank supports
criteria.personal_details: Changing name, address or other personal details
criteria.eligibility: Who can open an account or get a card: age limits, accounts for children, supported countries of residence
